caption: Supplementary Figure S1 | Monitoring geometry in spatial validation. (A) Training and test station counts for 154 country/task/fold records; filled and open markers distinguish training and test sets, color denotes task, and shape denotes fold. The count axis is logarithmic. (B) Available training-to-test distance summaries for 78 records: lines span minimum to P90, with median markers. NA labels give counts of unavailable distance summaries (United States: 5; Canada: 15). Small offsets separate overlapping records.
